note: Elements the crawler finds that carry no data-track and are not clickable controls in their own right. Keys are exact CSS selectors per page. Each entry says why in events or ignored, and n when the count is fixed. The gate fails when a selector matches nothing (stale) or the wrong number of elements. Nothing here is a blanket ignore.

canvas#cv.ignored: the analysed ad, display only. Interaction on it is not tracked: nothing here reads pointer input.

canvas#ov.ignored: overlay layer drawn over the ad (heatmap, gaze, text, faces), display only. Layer toggles are the tracked buttons.

canvas#abA, canvas#abB.ignored: A/B preview canvases, display only. The slot pickers and files carry data-track.

figure > canvas.ignored: colour-vision simulation thumbnails built on analysis (typical, protan, deutan, tritan), display only

canvas#simCanvas.ignored: population simulation drawing, display only. Run controls carry data-track.

canvas#poster.ignored: the generated poster, display only. Palette, regenerate and PNG controls carry data-track.

canvas#chart.ignored: ROAS curve drawing, display only. The sliders carry data-track.
